---
title: Download example models
---

For each wflow model a test model is available that can help to understand the data
requirements and the usage of each model. The TOML configuration file per available model are
listed in the Table below:

| model | TOML configuration file |
| :--- | :--- |
| wflow\_sbm + kinematic wave | `sbm_config.toml` |
| wflow\_sbm + groundwater flow | `sbm_gwf_piave_demand_config.toml` |
| wflow_sediment | `sediment_config.toml` |

Each archive contains the TOML configuration and its associated input static, forcing and state
files. Download and extract an example model to run it. See also [Usage](./running_wflow.qmd#running-a-simulation)
and [Command Line Interface](./running_wflow.qmd#using-the-command-line-interface).

## wflow\_sbm + kinematic wave

[Download the wflow_sbm example model](https://s3.deltares.nl/wflow/examples/dev/wflow-sbm-example.zip)

## wflow\_sbm + groundwater flow

[Download the wflow_sbm groundwater flow example model](https://s3.deltares.nl/wflow/examples/dev/wflow-sbm-gwf-example.zip)

## wflow\_sediment

[Download the wflow_sediment example model](https://s3.deltares.nl/wflow/examples/dev/wflow-sediment-example.zip)
